breakdown.description: The transverse modulus should follow the inverse rule of mixtures, not the parallel rule.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the parallel rule of mixtures (E_T = V_f E_f + V_m E_m) instead of the inverse rule of mixtures (1/E_T = V_f/E_f + V_m/E_m). The agent repeated the original error from the incomplete prompt, resulting in a calculated value of ~139 GPa, whereas the correct inverse rule would yield approximately 8.5 GPa for the same material parameters.
